visual.description: Sticky navigation bar with search left, centered logo, account and cart icons right, and a full-width secondary nav row with evenly spaced category links.
Full-viewport-width video/image hero with a single italic text label overlaid at bottom-left corner.
Uniform 4-column grid of equal-width product category cards, each with an image above and an all-caps label below; rows repeat without variation.
Full-bleed horizontal carousel of runway images that overflow both left and right viewport edges, with a pagination counter (01/61) aligned right.
Narrow centered text column with an italic serif heading and a short paragraph, sitting on a light cream background between image sections.
One large full-width editorial photograph occupying the entire horizontal span of the page.
Two equal-width tall editorial images side by side with no visible gutter, filling the full page width.
Full-bleed horizontal carousel of close-up detail/accessory images bleeding off both sides, with a right-aligned pagination counter (01/14).
Narrow centered italic serif heading with a short body paragraph on a light cream background, separating two image sections.
Full-width dark atmospheric image taking the entire horizontal span of the page.
Minimal cream-background section with a single centered underlined text link.

Footer split into four equal columns with all-caps category headings and plain text links below each, followed by a secondary row with customer service, newsletter subscribe, and social icons in three columns.
Bottom footer strip with ship-to country selector left and copyright text right.
